criterion: Same fact shown with two different values
description: Sidebar Files badge shows the number of loaded rows (100) while the drive strip shows the real total (114 files).
expected: Badge shows the drive's total (114) or is clearly labelled as loaded rows.
actual: Badge says 100 until 'Load more files' is clicked, then 114.
suggested_fix: Use the usage total for the badge, or drop the badge.

criterion: Search covers the whole data set
description: The filter only matches the file path of rows already loaded; it ignores the AUTHOR and MODIFIED columns, and a drive of thousands of files needs many Load more clicks before a miss means anything.
expected: Searching 'trace-bot' or a date finds matching files across the whole drive (server-side search exists for agents).
actual: 'trace-bot' returns 'No loaded files match' even though the drive has files by that author.
suggested_fix: Wire the filter to the existing search endpoint, or at least match the author column.

description: A positive state ('Key backed up ... (file)') is shown with a red/orange LED dot, the same colour used for warnings and the primary button.
expected: Neutral or green indicator for a healthy state.
actual: Red-orange dot beside a reassuring message.
suggested_fix: Dim LED for backed-up state, red only for missing backup.

description: The files card keeps a blank band (about 55px) under the footer line when few rows are shown, and the card height jumps when the filter changes the row count.
actual: Empty padding under the footer row; card resizes on every keystroke.
suggested_fix: Remove the min-height reserve under the footer.
